                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Curved surface area of the dome = 616 cm2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Curved surface area of a hemisphere = 2πr2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Diameter = 2 × radius

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Curved surface area = 2πr2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 616 = 2 × (22/7) × r2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = (616 × 7) / (2 × 22)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r2 = 98

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = √98

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r = 7 × √2 ≈ 7 × 1.41

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r ≈ 9.87 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diameter = 2 × r

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diameter ≈ 2 × 9.87

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Diameter ≈ 19.8 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 19.8 cm.

                                                                                                                                          \n", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गुंबद का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 616 सेमी2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2πr2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          व्यास = 2 × त्रिज्या

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Original cylinder height = H

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Original cylinder radius = R

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Smaller cylinder height = H / 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Smaller cylinder radius = R / 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Volume of a cylinder = π × r2 × h

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Fraction unused = (Original volume - Smaller volume) / Original volume

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Original volume = π × R2 × H

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Smaller volume = π × (R / 2)2 × (H / 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Smaller volume = π × (R2 / 4) × (H / 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Smaller volume = π × R2 × H / 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Fraction unused = (π × R2 × H - π × R2 × H / 16) / (π × R2 × H)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Fraction unused = (1 - 1 / 16)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Fraction unused = 15 / 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 15 / 16.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட சூத்திரம்:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          பயன்படுத்தப்படாத பின்னம் = (அசல் கன அளவு - சிறிய கன அளவு) / அசல் கன அளவு

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Side length of both polygons = a

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Regular triangle → 3 sides

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of regular hexagon = 6 × area of equilateral triangle of side a

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of regular hexagon:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Ahex = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Ahex = (6√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Ahex = (3√3 ÷ 2) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of regular triangle:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Atri = (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Required ratio:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Ahex : Atri

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (3√3 ÷ 2) × a2 : (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (3 ÷ 2) : (1 ÷ 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6 : 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The required ratio is 6 : 1.

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Base of column = equilateral triangle

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Side of triangle = 8 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Heights of levels:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Level 1 = 10 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Level 2 = 12 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Level 3 = 14 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Level 4 = 16 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Level 5 = 18 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          √3 ≈ 1.732

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Volume = Base area × Height

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Area of triangular base:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = (1.732 ÷ 4) × 82

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = (1.732 ÷ 4) × 64

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Area = 27.712 cm2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Sum of heights:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 10 + 12 + 14 + 16 + 18 = 70 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Total volume:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume = 27.712 × 70

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Volume = 1939.84 cm3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The total volume of the column is approximately 1939.84 cm3.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          స్థాయి 5 = 18 సెం.మీ

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          √3 ≈ 1.732

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          సమబాహు త్రిభుజ వైశాల్యం = (√3 ÷ 4) x a2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ఘనపరిమాణం = భూ వైశాల్యం x ఎత్తు

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Coordinates (-2, -4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Slope = -6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Equation of a line: y - y1 = m(x - x1)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y - (-4) = -6(x - (-2))

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y + 4 = -6(x + 2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y + 4 = -6x - 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = -6x - 12 - 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = -6x - 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is y = -6x - 16.

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          रेखा का समीकरण: y - y1 = m(x - x1)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y - (-4) = -6(x - (-2))

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y + 4 = -6(x + 2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y + 4 = -6x - 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = -6x - 12 - 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ y = -6x - 16

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर y = -6x - 16 है।

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          1. To solve for m: Isolate m on one side of the equation.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6m - 24 = 12

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6m = 12 + 24

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 6m = 36

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ m = 36 / 6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ m = 6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 6.

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Center point (centroid) G = (2 , 4)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Point A = (6 , −2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Point B = (−4 , 8)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Centroid of triangle:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          G = (xA + xB + xC) ÷ 3 , (yA + yB + yC) ÷ 3

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Length of direct shared tangent: √(d2 - (r1 - r2)2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Given that the length of the tangent equals the distance between the centers:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ √(d2 - (r1 - r2)2) = d

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Squaring both sides:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ d2 - (r1 - r2)2 = d2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ -(r1 - r2)2 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r1 - r2 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r1 = r2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is r1 = r2.

                                                                                                                                          ସୂତ୍ର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଇଛି:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ସିଧା ଅଂଶୀକୃତ ସ୍ପର୍ଶକର ଲମ୍ବ: √(d2 - (r1 - r2)2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ଦିଆଯାଇଛି ଯେ ସ୍ପର୍ଶକର ଲମ୍ବ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ଦୂରତା ସହିତ ସମାନ:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ √(d2 - (r1 - r2)2) = d

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ଉଭୟ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ବର୍ଗ କରିବା:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ d2 - (r1 - r2)2 = d2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ -(r1 - r2)2 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r1 - r2 = 0

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ r1 = r2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି r1 = r2।

                                                                                                                                          Length of support beam (chord) = 4√21 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Distance of the beam from the center = 10 cm

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          In a circle:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          (Half of chord)2 + (Distance from center)2 = Radius2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          सपोर्ट बीम (जीवा) की लंबाई = 4√21 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          केंद्र से बीम की दूरी = 10 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          एक वृत्त में:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          (जीवा का आधा)2 + (केंद्र से दूरी)2 = त्रिज्या2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          गणना:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ जीवा का आधा = (4√21) ÷ 2 = 2√21

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (2√21)2 = 4 × 21 = 84

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ केंद्र से दूरी2 = 102 = 100

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या2 = 84 + 100

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या2 = 184

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या = √184

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या = 2√46

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ √46 ≈ 6.78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या ≈ 2 × 6.78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ त्रिज्या ≈ 13.56 सेमी

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ वृत्ताकार खिड़की की त्रिज्या लगभग 13.56 सेमी है।

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Combined value of sin A and cos A = x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Identity: sin2A + cos2A + 2 × (sin A × cos A)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sin2A + cos2A = 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sin A + cos A = xఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ఆధారం పుంజం (జ్యా) పొడవు = 4√21 సెం.మీ

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          మధ్య నుండి పుంజం యొక్క దూరం = 10 సెం.మీ

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ఒక వృత్తంలో:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          (జ్యాలో సగం)2 + (మధ్య నుండి దూరం)2 = వ్యాసార్థం2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ జ్యాలో సగం = (4√21) ÷ 2 = 2√21

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (2√21)2 = 4 x 21 = 84

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ మధ్య నుండి దూరం2 = 102 = 100

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం2 = 84 + 100

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం2 = 184

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం = √184

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం = 2√46

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ √46 ≈ 6.78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం ≈ 2 x 6.78

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ వ్యాసార్థం ≈ 13.56 సెం.మీ

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ వృత్తాకార కిటికీ యొక్క వ్యాసార్థం సుమారుగా 13.56 సెం.మీ.

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Combined value of sin A and cos A = x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Identity: sin2A + cos2A + 2 × (sin A × cos A)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sin2A + cos2A = 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sin A + cos A = x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          (sin A + cos A)2 = sin2A + cos2A + 2 × (sin A × cos A)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (sin A + cos A)2 = sin2A + cos2A + 2 × (sin A × cos A)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ x2 = 1 + 2 × (sin A × cos A)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sin2A + cos2A + 2 × (sin A × cos A) = x2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is x2.

{"prompt": "4", "value": "1 / 4"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sine x = cosine x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Required: sine4x + cosine4x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          sine2x + cosine2x = 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          a4 + b4 = (a2 + b2)2 - 2a2b2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine x = cosine x implies sine2x = cosine2x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine2x + cosine2x = 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 2sine2x = 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine2x = 1 / 2 and cosine2x = 1 / 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Now, sine4x + cosine4x = (sine2x + cosine2x)2 - 2 × sine2x × cosine2x

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine4x + cosine4x = (1)2 - 2 × (1 / 2) × (1 / 2)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine4x + cosine4x = 1 - 2 × 1 / 4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine4x + cosine4x = 1 - 1 / 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ sine4x + cosine4x = 1 / 2

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 1 / 2.

                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          n = 0.4

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          o = −0.6

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Formula used:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          m3 + n3 + o3 − 3mno = (m + n + o)(m2 + n2 + o2 − mn − no − om)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          If m + n + o = 0, then:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ m3 + n3 + o3 = 3mno

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ m3 + n3 + o3 = 3mno

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ (m3 + n3 + o3) ÷ (3 × m × n × o)

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 3mno ÷ 3mno

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ⇒ 1

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          ∴ The required value is 1.

                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: It is prudent to save a portion of your income for emergencies.
                                                                                                                                              • \n

                                                                                                                                            • \n\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: She was wary of investing in a new business without proper research.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                          • Hence, the most appropriate synonym for \"Prudent\" is \"Wary.\"
                                                                                                                                            • \n

                                                                                                                                          • The idiom \"Butter someone up\" refers to excessively praising or flattering someone, usually with the intention of gaining something in return.

                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                                          Complete Explanation: \"Butter someone up\" means to praise or flatter someone excessively, often to gain favor or achieve a particular goal.\"

                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Zoo.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                          • The word \"Zoo\" refers to a place where animals are kept, displayed, and often cared for by professionals. (चिड़ियाघर)\n

                                                                                                                                              • \n

                                                                                                                                          • \"Sanctuary\" is a place where animals are protected and conserved in their natural habitat. (अभयारण्य)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The bird sanctuary is home to many rare species of birds.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • \"Aquarium\" is a tank or building where aquatic animals and plants are kept for display or study. (मत्स्यालय)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The aquarium had a beautiful display of colorful fish and coral reefs.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • \"Reserve\" refers to a protected area designated for the conservation of wildlife and natural resources. (आरक्षित क्षेत्र)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The tiger reserve ensures the safety of endangered tiger species.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Zoo.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n
