                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Morgue.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                          • The word \"Morgue\" refers to a place where dead bodies are preserved temporarily, usually before burial or cremation. (मुर्दाघर)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: After the tragic accident, the bodies were taken to the morgue for identification.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • \"Graveyard\" refers to an area, usually near a church, where dead bodies are buried. (कब्रिस्तान)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The graveyard was peaceful and surrounded by old trees.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • \"Mausoleum\" refers to a building constructed as a tomb for housing the remains of the dead. (समाधि)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The Taj Mahal is an iconic mausoleum built by Shah Jahan.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          • \"Pyre\" refers to a pile of wood on which a dead body is burnt during cremation. (चिता)\n
                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                            • Example: The funeral pyre was lit as part of the final rites.
                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                            \n
                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Morgue.

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                • Passive Voice: The proposal was rejected by the board.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                • Active Voice: To convert a sentence from passive to active voice, identify the subject performing the action and place it at the beginning of the sentence, followed by the verb and the object.
                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                • Conversion:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                  • The subject performing the action (board) becomes the subject of the sentence.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                  • The verb (was rejected) changes to its active form (rejected).
                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                  • The object (the proposal) follows the verb.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                  • Option 1 (\"despite his effort\") is incorrect because it changes the meaning slightly.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n

                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                  • Option 4 (\"in spite he tried\") is grammatically incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                  • Option 1: \"despite his effort\" is incorrect because it uses a noun phrase instead of a verb phrase, which changes the intended meaning.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                  • Option 2: \"although he tried hard\" is incorrect because it introduces a new clause and alters the sentence structure unnecessarily.
                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                  • Option 4: \"in spite he tried\" is grammatically incorrect because \"in spite\" must be followed by \"of\".
                                                                                                                                                    • \nThe correct answer is: Option (2) i.e. They stimulate innovative approaches.

                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                    • The passage states that constraints or limitations often push individuals to explore unconventional approaches, meaning they encourage or stimulate innovation. (सीमाएं अक्सर लोगों को नवाचार के लिए प्रेरित करती हैं।)
                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                    • Rather than suppressing creativity, limitations can force creative problem-solving and unique solutions.
                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                    • This is why supportive environments that embrace experimentation and risk-taking are important for fostering creativity.
                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is- They stimulate innovative approaches

                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                    • They suppress originality (वे मौलिकता को दबाते हैं): The passage suggests the opposite—limitations can enhance creativity.
                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                    • They eliminate experimentation (वे प्रयोग को समाप्त करते हैं): The passage says rigid models do this, not limitations in general.
